*As for* here rests on a real morpheme, the fronting לְ of לָאוֹפַנִּים (rule 30, headed on *As* by rule 24), unlike the bare casus pendens of 10:10 and 10:22.
The impersonal קרא לְ recast as a personal passive leaves the second לְ `unrepresented` and gives its suffix the subject pronoun *they* (rules 40, 18).
